function.name: geocode_address
function.description: Transforms a description of a location (like a pair of coordinates, an address, or a name of a place) to a location on the Earth's surface. Note that the provided function is in Python 3 syntax.

address.description: The address that needs to be geocoded.

locale.description: Preferred locale for the returned address information. (Optional) Default: None

message.content: 抱歉，我目前無法提供即時的交通資訊。若您需要最新的路況，建議使用 Google Maps、Apple Maps 或其他即時交通服務查看。

We can use the geocode_address function to get coordinates for New York. But we don't have a function to get traffic data. There's no tool for traffic. So we cannot fetch real-time traffic. We should respond that we can't provide real-time traffic. Possibly we can give general advice or mention typical traffic patterns. But we cannot provide real-time data. So we should politely say we don't have real-time traffic data.
